feature_definitions.ear_left: Anatomical left eye EAR: (d(p1,p5)+d(p2,p4))/(2*d(p0,p3)); pixel xy; eye_indices.left.
feature_definitions.ear_right: Anatomical right eye EAR: same formula; pixel xy; eye_indices.right.
feature_definitions.perclos_4s: Closed valid slots / valid slots over last 100 slots; full window and >=80% valid required.
feature_definitions.closed_duration_s: Seconds since observed open-to-closed onset; unknown start or missing eye evidence => invalid.
feature_definitions.head_yaw_deg: Upstream yaw degrees only; camera x right, y down, z forward; R=Rz(roll)Ry(yaw)Rx(pitch). Not gaze.
feature_definitions.head_pitch_deg: Upstream pitch degrees in same rotation convention; no pose estimator in this bridge.
feature_definitions.head_roll_deg: Upstream roll degrees in same rotation convention.
feature_definitions.phone_conf: Maximum qualifying phone score with box center in fixed driver ROI; fresh successful empty detection => valid zero.
feature_definitions.drink_object_conf: Maximum qualifying bottle/cup score in ROI; ties resolved deterministically; not drinking probability.
feature_definitions.phone_face_distance: Selected phone box center to face bbox center / face bbox diagonal; same selected candidate as confidence.
feature_definitions.drink_mouth_distance: Selected drink box center to midpoint of landmarks13/14 / face bbox diagonal.
feature_definitions.blink_rate_per_min: Completed open-closed-open events lasting80..500ms entirely within100-slot window; all eye slots valid; count*15.
feature_definitions.phone_hand_distance: Minimum rectangle gap from selected phone to confirmed driver hand bbox / driver ROI diagonal; not physical contact.
feature_definitions.phone_hand_iou: Intersection over union of the same phone-hand pair selected by minimum gap.
feature_definitions.phone_near_duration_s: Seconds of observed near run with stable object track; target switch restarts; missing/unknown onset => invalid.
feature_definitions.drink_hand_distance: Minimum rectangle gap from selected bottle/cup to confirmed driver hand bbox / driver ROI diagonal.
feature_definitions.drink_hand_iou: Intersection over union of the same drink-hand pair selected by minimum gap.
feature_definitions.drink_near_duration_s: Seconds of observed drink-hand near run with stable object track; same reset policy as phone.
